# HKLL — Bulk Reconstruction

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “HKLL smearing bulk operator”).

claims.name: nonperturbative_violations_bulk_microcausality_achieved
claims.statement: Non-perturbative violations of bulk micro-causality can be achieved by implementing a late boundary time cut-off while smearing the boundary operator via the HKLL kernel.
